verdict.rationale: Pulley's docs show bulk cap-table migration via Excel/Carta import, treating the spreadsheet as the source of truth for populating many securities/stakeholders at once (pulley-docs-1, pulley-docs-14, pulley-docs-15, pulley-docs-2), which covers bulk-loading historical transactions. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk-grant issuance workflow (e.g., uploading a batch of new option grants post-migration) distinct from the one-time cap table import. Missing for 10: evidence of an ongoing bulk-grant-issuance tool (not just initial migration), and any independent/hands-on confirmation of the bulk upload process working smoothly.
